objective: Attack TERMINAL-USEFULNESS rather than history-aware well-foundedness by constructing an arbitrarily large high-port root-class family whose monotone source-exposure rank descends almost to global exposure while separators are absent, the active interface grows, and all consecutive exposed blocks of sizes at most three are strictly same-boundary irreducible.

atomic_claims.text: For every even N at least 6, the explicitly oriented double-ring family T_N is a simple plane triangulation with 2N+2 vertices, 6N edges, minimum indegree and outdegree at least two, pole degree N, and no nonfacial 3-cycle.

Along the consecutive A-star exposure sweep in T_N, the controlled boundary has exact size |B_t|=t+4 for 1<=t<=N-2, and after N-1 A-star exposures only D is unseen; therefore the history-aware unseen-vertex rank can decrease for arbitrarily many steps while the interface grows.

For either parity and every consecutive A-star block of size k=1,2,3 in T_N, no strictly smaller same-boundary simple plane oriented replacement Q satisfies the necessary ordinary-extension condition Ext(Q) subseteq Ext(P); hence no strong-profile replacement exists in those scopes.

Within this root-class stress model, history-aware well-foundedness plus separator decomposition and same-boundary local reduction on blocks of size at most three does not force an early useful terminal; any universal bounded-cluster usefulness theorem of that form requires block size at least four or genuinely nonlocal/source-specific information.

assumptions: T_N is used only as a root-class high-port stress family, not as an asserted exact C37 higher-degree, LSRC, GSRC or JMAP state.
Ordinary same-boundary replacement requires the same oriented boundary and fewer internal vertices; strong positive-reachability replacement implies the ordinary extension condition tested here.

It is sufficient to enumerate maximal triangulated replacement disks: any nonmaximal Q satisfying Ext(Q) subseteq Ext(P) can be completed by arbitrarily oriented diagonals to a maximal Q' with Ext(Q') subseteq Ext(Q).
The history-aware rank itself is accepted for this attack as a finite discovery rank; Cycle 3 tests only whether such descent forces useful local structure before near-global exposure.
risks: Blocks of size at least four were not classified, so no arbitrary-radius hardness theorem is claimed.
A nonlocal reduction or a future source-specific GSRC/JMAP theorem may supply usefulness or exclude T_N.
The exhaustive checker is same-principal candidate-generation code and is not a registered independent verifier receipt.
No exact C37 d(7)>=7 source bridge is supplied, so this result is not promoted into the current C37 source lineage.
No EvidenceLink, Result, Solution, trusted verification or root closure is supplied.

failed_route_proposal.blocker: The inference that history-aware discovery well-foundedness plus separating-triangle decomposition and same-boundary reductions on clusters of at most three exposed complete stars must yield an early useful terminal fails in the root-class family T_N: the rank descends almost to full exposure, separators are absent, the interface grows, and all such clusters are same-boundary irreducible.
